company_profile.description: A profile for established food operations that need temporary production capacity during demand spikes, equipment outages, or facility work.

service_profile.service_description: Mobile kitchen trailer rental for commercial kitchen overflow. A profile for established food operations that need temporary production capacity during demand spikes, equipment outages, or facility work.

cooking: For commercial kitchen overflow, each kitchen includes a stove, oven, and essential cooking utensils to support commercial kitchen expansion and equipment outage coverage. Additional equipment options are available through 24/7 support.
refrigeration: For commercial kitchen overflow, a separate temporary mobile refrigerator trailer can support commercial kitchen expansion and equipment outage coverage. Pricing is 20 ft $2,486, 25 ft $2,986, 30 ft $3,486, 35 ft $3,986, and 40 ft $4,486. These are site-wide starting estimates after the site adjustment; refrigerator trailer pricing is published site-wide. Capacity, configuration, and availability are handled through 24/7 support.
preparation: To support commercial kitchen expansion and equipment outage coverage, preparation areas and requested equipment are reviewed before delivery for sanitation, functionality, site fit, and readiness. Additional equipment may be rented as needed for a site serving restaurants and hotels, including access items such as stairs and ramps. The same preparation, equipment, and sanitation checks are repeated during off-rent maintenance.
sanitation: For commercial kitchen overflow, every kitchen facility follows a sanitation plan before delivery, after the rental, and while the trailer is off rent for maintenance. The plan covers food-contact areas, sanitation-related connections, condition records, and readiness for the next dispatch.
storage: Storage needs for commercial kitchen expansion and equipment outage coverage can be reviewed with the selected kitchen configuration. Dry or cold storage options are available based on site requirements and the approved equipment package.
utilities: For commercial kitchen overflow, the site is reviewed before delivery for approved power capacity and connection type, potable water supply, wastewater or gray-water drainage, fuel or gas requirements where applicable, ventilation clearances, trailer placement, access, stairs or ramps, and any required permits or inspections. Requirements depend on the trailer configuration and site conditions and are verified with the company before dispatch.

preparation_plan.purpose: Prepare each mobile kitchen facility and requested supporting equipment for restaurants and hotels managing commercial kitchen expansion and equipment outage coverage, then keep it deployment-ready between rentals.

Document service needs, complete approved maintenance, and verify the configuration is ready for the next commercial kitchen overflow assignment.

utilities_plan.power: For commercial kitchen overflow, verify the approved power source, capacity, connection type, and connection location for the selected trailer configuration.

utilities_plan.fuel: For the equipment package selected for restaurants and hotels and commercial kitchen expansion and equipment outage coverage, verify propane, natural gas, or other approved fuel requirements where applicable.

utilities_plan.confirmation_note: Exact utility specifications for commercial kitchen overflow depend on the trailer configuration and site conditions and are verified with the company before dispatch.

sanitation_plan.purpose: Maintain a clean, safe, and deployment-ready kitchen facility throughout the rental lifecycle for commercial kitchen overflow.
before_delivery: Clean and sanitize food-contact surfaces, cooking areas, preparation areas, dishwashing areas, and refrigeration interiors.
Check sanitation-related water, drainage, waste, and connection points before dispatch.
Document the trailer condition and verify that the facility is ready for commercial kitchen expansion and equipment outage coverage delivery and setup.
after_rental: After the commercial kitchen overflow rental, remove food, waste, and customer-supplied materials from the facility.

Inspect the facility, document cleaning and condition findings, and record any repair or service needs before the trailer is released.

Complete scheduled inspection and maintenance of kitchen, dishwasher, refrigerator, water, drainage, and related operating components.
Resolve documented service items and verify sanitation readiness before the trailer is assigned to the next commercial kitchen overflow rental.
sanitation_plan.confirmation_note: Final sanitation, inspection, and maintenance records for commercial kitchen overflow should be verified through company operations before delivery and before the next rental assignment.

faqs.question: When does overflow rental make sense?
faqs.answer: It can be considered when demand, repairs, or facility work create a temporary capacity gap that does not justify permanent expansion.

faqs.question: Can the trailer supplement an existing kitchen?
faqs.answer: A supplemental configuration may be possible when workflows, utilities, access, and food-safety responsibilities are reviewed together.

faqs.question: How should I divide work between the permanent and mobile kitchens?
faqs.answer: Separate tasks by equipment, prep stage, menu, and service window, then confirm the proposed workflow with the company.

faqs.question: Can the rental cover a peak season only?
faqs.answer: Seasonal terms may be available. Minimum rental, date holds, and extension rules require company-approved details.

faqs.question: What equipment category should I prioritize?
faqs.answer: Prioritize the bottleneck—cooking, refrigeration, preparation, storage, sanitation, or utilities—rather than selecting equipment by name alone.

faqs.question: Can I expand the configuration later?
faqs.answer: Configuration changes depend on inventory, site limits, and company approval: company-approved details.
